correctness.rationale: From the exact negative-binomial generating function, differentiation yields E[N q^(N-1)]=mu(1+z/k)^(-k-1) at fixed mean. The derivative sign factors through H(z/k)-z. The displayed H derivative is strictly positive and H spans (2,infinity), proving the entire quantified optimizer classification with endpoints. Taylor expansion and log inversion prove the sharp k*(z) and recruitment asymptotics; an explicit pairwise log-ratio derivative shows exactly one crossing at z>1. All mathematical limits and strictness are established analytically. The attached standard-library checker was run from the actual package source and printed PASS: 263 deterministic diagnostic assertions; this is supplementary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A constant mean isolates spatial clustering from changes in overall propagule supply; the exactly quantified threshold z=2 separates unclustered-optimal from uniquely intermediate-clustered-optimal recruitment. The unique optimizer and asymptotic scales identify the strength of clustering needed under competition, and universal pairwise one-crossing excludes ranking oscillations as crowding varies. This completes a naturally motivated finite-site recruitment optimization, not just a renamed standard probability identity or arbitrary numerical slice. Ecological predictive use remains conditional on the explicitly idealized response.
